title: Outer verifier local bits
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions, let $w$ be a Boolean input word of length $n$, and let $p$ be a Boolean proof word of length $m$. For each verifier seed, the outer local bit at each of the $r$ query positions is the value of the combined input-and-proof word at the verifier’s query address, using input position $0$ when the query is absent.
